name: Atlantis (STS-37)
about: Atlantis (STS-37) (1991-027A), a crewed vehicle (OV-104), launched 1991 Apr  5. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1991 Apr  7), held fixed
